instruction.text: Sarah ist zurück von ihrem Wochenend-Trip nach New York und erzählt ihrer amerikanischen Freundin Emma was sie erlebt hat. Vervollständige den Dialog zwischen den beiden.

hint.text: Aufgepasst, bei dieser Aufgabe musst du manchmal auch etwas selber schreiben. Das gesuchte Wort steht dann über dem Text in der Sprechblase.

atoms.b: Hi Sarah! Good to see you again. How was your trip to ((New_York_City New_York))? What did you do there?
Hello Emma. Thanks for asking, it was great. Well first, I visited a famous ((++landmark run-down_building department_store)) called the Empire State Building.
Wow, that's a must-see. It's so tall, and you must have had an amazing view of the ((city))!
Yes, after that, I walked along ((++Fifth_Avenue Central_Park Hudson_River)) and did some shopping. There are so many big ((++department_stores restaurants repairmen)) there.
Nice! Did you go to any ((theaters theatres)) or see a show?

hint.text: Bei einer Frage dieser Art benötigst du die Pluralform des gesuchten Nomens.

atoms.b: Actually, yes! I watched a fantastic Broadway show near ((++Times_Square Flatiron Brooklyn_Bridge)). The lights and the energy were incredible!
Sounds like a perfect day! Did you explore any other ((neighbourhoods))?

hint.text: Bei einer Frage dieser Art benötigst du die Pluralform des gesuchten Nomens.

atoms.b: Definitely! I went to ((++Chinatown Little_Italy Harlem)) and tried some delicious Chinese food. The atmosphere there is so vibrant!
That's great! You probably went there by ((subway)). Did you cross any iconic bridges?
Oh yes, I walked across the ((Brooklyn_Bridge)). The view of Manhattan and the Hudson River from there is breathtaking.
It sounds like you covered a lot in one weekend! Did you see anything unusual?
Well, I noticed a ((run-down)) building in one corner, but it was surrounded by all these amazing places. New York is full of surprises!
Absolutely! It's a city with a mix of old and new. I'm glad you had a fantastic day exploring the ((Big_Apple)).
Thanks Emma! It was an unforgettable experience.
